scope: current-canonical byte-exact recomposition of qualified F-SI30/F-KT14 preconditions only

invariants.rationale: Recomposition preserves the single SWAP kernel; no alternate product kernel is introduced.
No file, format, path or parsing dependency is introduced into kernel source.
Existing parameter/state/forcing/numerical/result separation is transplanted byte-exact from qualified donor source.
No new persistent per-column state is introduced by F-KT15R.
Existing Richards workspace and tangent scratch ownership remain worker/local as qualified upstream.
No storage-layout or batching semantics are changed.
Accepted-only result transport and retry/rollback stale-result exclusion are preserved from F-KT14; no new transaction route is implemented here.
No recomputation or warm-start semantics are changed.
No day/calendar assumption is introduced; time contracts are unchanged.
No coupling-window duration or midnight assumption is introduced.
Qualified transaction/result seams needed for future coupling are restored on current canonical without claiming production coupling.
No MODFLOW sign conversion or H_SWAP/H_MF enforcement is added in this recomposition.
Hard mass-conservation behavior is replayed through F-SI30 dynamic HeadCalc execution; no tolerance or mass policy is changed.
F-SI28 same-factorization qbot interface sensitivity and F-KT14 accepted transport remain first-class typed outputs.
No additional nonlinear trajectory or Jacobian build is introduced; upstream sensitivity remains same-factorization/backsolve based.
No per-column heavyweight solver ownership or MultiSWAP execution model is changed.
No 1:1 MODFLOW-cell mapping or tile assumption is introduced.
No deep-vadose component or deep-recharge interpretation is changed.
No component transition or stored-water transfer semantics are changed.
Typed soil-water solver contracts and provider interfaces from qualified donor source are restored without hard-wiring other modules to one solver implementation.
No duplicate crop/ET/drainage/surface physics is added.
Typed solver/result/provider interfaces are preserved; no new consumer is coupled to HeadCalc internal arrays.
No physical option or numerical policy is silently altered.
No runtime fallback, retry cost, or solver policy is changed by recomposition.
Reference/full-accuracy route is not removed or weakened.
Existing typed solver diagnostics including sensitivity backsolve counters are preserved from qualified authorities.
No optional capability is made unconditional and no new state allocation is introduced.
No tile/system composition is moved into the SWAP kernel.
F-KT15R pins canonical base, donor authority and exact path allowlist; it adds no silent file/day/MODFLOW dependency.
This explicit 30-invariant audit plus exact-source and upstream replay gates qualify the architecture change.

hard_nonclaims: F-KT15 SoilWater task-2 typed production composition is not implemented by F-KT15R.
No production SWAP-MODFLOW coupling is admitted.
No MODFLOW sign mapping or whole-coupling-window derivative is claimed.
No numeric H_app, A_temporal or project head-error budget is selected.
Immutable RB1 is not modified or reopened.
